Problem Statement
Read whether a worker has an ID card and is wearing a helmet. Print whether the worker can enter the factory. 
Description
A factory gate checks every worker before letting them in. First, the worker must show an ID card. If there is no ID card, print Show ID Card. If the worker has an ID card, then the helmet is checked. If the worker is not wearing a helmet, print Wear Helmet. If the worker has both, print Entry Allowed. 
Input Description
Two integers, each on a separate line. The first is 1 if the worker has an ID card, otherwise 0. The second is 1 if the worker is wearing a helmet, otherwise 0. 
Output Description
Print exactly one of these: Entry Allowed, Wear Helmet or Show ID Card. Match the capital letters and spaces exactly.

1
0

Wear Helmet
